summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of CubiQo 3D plasma wave animation - ALL features working correctly including morph animation, landing page, UI elements, and state management
passed_tests: Landing page shows plasma waves animation with 'CUBIQO' title
Landing page shows 'One Mind. Many Dimensions' subtitle
Landing page shows 'TAP ANYWHERE TO BEGIN' prompt
Clicking landing page navigates to main app page
App page shows plasma waves animation in default state with 120,000+ particles
Speaker 'Enable' button is visible at bottom of app page
Clicking Enable button morphs plasma waves into cube formation
Orange soul nodes are visible floating in the center (confirmed visually)
Enable button shows pulse animation rings when active
Enable text label hides when voice is enabled (opacity-0 class applied)
Speaker icon wrapper gets active styling (bg-white/15)
Clicking Enable button again returns to wave state
Header shows CubiQo™ title (TM superscript)
Header shows SIGNAL branding with 'One is enough' tagline
Sample questions scroll on the left side (visible in screenshots)
RGY indicators visible on right side (traffic light pattern)
Keywords button visible on right side
Settings button visible in footer
Sign In button visible in footer
Footer shows confidentiality text
Footer shows Powered by Claude and OpenAI logos
3D Canvas renders correctly (1 canvas element present)
WebGL context functioning (GPU warnings are normal performance hints)
State persists after animation toggle
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core features of the 3D plasma wave animation are working. The morph from waves to cube is triggered by clicking the Enable button (data-testid='voice-control-button'). Landing page appears once per session or after 4+ hours (controlled by localStorage 'cubiqo_last_landing'). Supabase auth is MOCKED with placeholder values in .env.local. WebGL GPU warnings in console are normal and don't affect rendering.

visual_verification.landing_page: Beautiful plasma wave ribbons with cyan→blue→purple→magenta→pink→orange gradient, CUBIQO title centered, 'One Mind. Many Dimensions' subtitle, ambient floating particles
visual_verification.default_state: Flowing plasma waves rendered as ribbon particles with orange soul nodes floating in center
visual_verification.enabled_state: Particles morph into rotating cube formation with concentrated center glow, pulse animation rings on button, Enable text hidden
visual_verification.ui_elements: Header with CubiQo™ logo, SIGNAL branding; Left side has scrolling sample questions; Right side has RGY indicators and Keywords button; Footer has Settings, Sign In, confidentiality text, Powered by logos
